lines.en: : Sana, are you up to anything right now?
: Sensei? Just...a minute, please!
I can hear Sana yell from behind her door.
Well, it’s not exactly a yell. This is still Sana we're talking about.
It’s more like the noise a mouse makes when you turn on the lights in the middle of the night and cause it to go scurrying off to the other side of the room.
Just...somehow even less intimidating.
: Um...G...Good evening...
: Hey. What's going on? You didn't have to come out of your room.
: Well...I was actually...on my way out already...
: Am I interrupting something?
: No, I just...thought I’d go for a walk tonight.
: Well, I graciously accept your invitation for me to come along.
: I...guess there's no stopping you now...
: Just so you know, though...I don’t really have anywhere in mind...
: So we might just...walk around in circles...or something...
: Wow. You really know how to have a good time, don’t you?
: I do my best...
: I could always...leave you behind...you know?
: Being seen with someone like you might...cramp my style...
: Who taught you to speak like this? Because it sure as Hell wasn’t me.
: I think Rin might be rubbing off on me...
: She’s also been...helping me get better at talking to people in her spare time...
Well...that definitely makes a little more sense than Sana just suddenly thinking she’s better than me.
Rin is essentially Kumon-mi's resident expert at playful banter, so Sana’s in good hands.
I just hope she doesn’t become a little...too much like Rin because I'm not quite sure how I'd handle her calling me homie.
: So...are you ready to go or...did you want to stop somewhere first?..
: Where would I even stop? Does the dorm suddenly have a gift shop that no one's told me about or something?
: No, I...I don’t know...
: I'm just...trying to be polite...
The two of us set off down the road and pass by several shops closing down for the night.
Sana doesn’t seem eager to stop at any of them...She literally just wants to walk. That's it.
Which is fine, I guess. I mean, I’m no stranger to going out without a gameplan in mind...
But the fact that Sana wants to do something like this with me is an occurrence I didn’t think would be happening for quite a while.
Maybe that talk we had on the beach helped her get a little more comfortable with me after all?
: Okay...we’ll stop here for now.
: Finished with your weird, aimless walking plan?
: It’s...only weird if you make it weird...
: What’s wrong with two friends going out for a walk in the middle of the night?...
: I told you during vacation that I start getting a little...happier once the weather changes.
: And tonight is the coldest it’s been in a while...
: Don’t you think so, Sensei?...
: I mean...Sure, I guess. I haven’t really been paying much attention to the weather.
: I’m not dying from heat exhaustion, though. So that’s definitely a good sign.
: Yeah...it’s kind of miraculous we’ve made it this far...isn’t it?
: Through Summer, I mean.
: Every time it rolls around, I think to myself...Sana...you’re going to go out and...do things...
: But then I take one look at the forecast and change my mind for the next six months...
: Does this mean you’re going to actually do things this winter?
: Maybe...
: Though...I’m not really sure what there is to do with my grand total of two friends...
: How about karaoke?
: I’ve heard some rather...unpleasant stories about how Ayane acts during karaoke.
I’m suddenly stricken with a traumatic flashback involving Ayane and some song she sung in Spanish.
Maybe it’s best if Sana doesn’t go down that path after all?...
: I...wouldn’t be surprised if Rin was a good singer, though...
: I can’t really speak to how good I would be since I’ve never really...done something like that before, but...
: How about you, Sensei? Are you a good singer?
: Is this you inviting me to Karaoke?
: As long as you can keep it a secret from Ayane.
: Ah! That came out wrong!
: I didn’t mean it like that!
: I just meant...so we wouldn’t have to hear Despacito!
: Calm down, I know what you meant.
: Guh...
: I really need to be more careful...
: I feel like the more I learn to actually speak with you...the worse I get at saying the right thing...
: Is that supposed to happen?
: I guess so. That sort of thing just comes with the territory.
: Ready for another lesson, Sana?
: You mean...right now?
: You normally only teach me speaking stuff at the bar...
: Now is as good a time as any. Please take note of this extremely vital information.
: Give it to me.
: Wait! That came out wrong too!
: Just teach me whatever it was you wanted to teach me!
: Right...well-
: The more you talk, the more mistakes you’ll make.
: You’d think that learning how to speak publicly would put an end to things like that, but it's actually the opposite.
: One of the biggest downsides to becoming a good speaker is that your mistakes become more visible than ever.
: Once people start associating you with your linguistic skills, those same people will pounce on any slip-up just so they can feel better about themselves.
: So, if you think your problems are just going to go away once you get the basics down, you’ve got another thing coming.
: That was a lot more detailed than a normal lesson...
: You didn’t even ask me to roleplay.
: To be fair, your roleplaying during that game you guys played over vacation left me a little intimidated.
: Which is strange because it was also one of the cutest things I’ve ever seen you do.
: I...was hoping you’d never bring that up...
: I got so wrapped up in the game that I...didn’t even realize you were there...
: But thank you. For actually teaching me something today.
: Even if your lesson was just...another cynical outlook on how people take advantage of others.
: Hey, at the end of the day, lessons like that are the ones that really matter.
: You never know when someone is going to just show up and ruin everything.
: Yeah, yeah...You’re a cynic...I get it.
: I don’t like what Rin is doing to you.
: Heheh...Even I’ll admit that it feels kind of weird being so casual with you...
: If I ever start calling you...homie, though...
: You can execute me.
: Thanks, Sana. I’ll remember that.
: Wait...
: You won’t...actually execute me...will you, Sensei?
: Sensei?...
: Why aren’t you saying anything?!
: Perhaps he has forgotten how?
: Oh, how pitiful it is to forget.
: To let go of something you love.
: Especially something as beautiful as speech itself.
: I take it that the two of you know each other well?
A mysterious girl appears before us spinning an umbrella around behind her back.
It hasn’t rained much since I’ve been reborn here, so I’m a bit curious as to why she’s carrying something like that around with her.
: Umm...he’s my...teacher...
: A teacher? That’s wonderful.
: It sounded like your lesson wasn’t going very well, though.
: To teach requires participation on both ends.
: So why has the man beside you suddenly gone quiet?
: Can we help you with something?
: Ahh...So you can speak after all...
: And here I was thinking that things were about to get interesting.
: Interesting?...What...do you mean?...
: Oh?
: You want to know?
: Well...you just...
: Hahah...hahahahahah!!!
: The end of days approaches!
: Before long, little things like these talks...the looks you give each other...will be naught but memories.
: And all of the time you two have spent will be wiped clean.
: Like old ink being stripped from a dry-erase board.
: The dawning of a new age is upon us.
: But for what purpose?
: And why now?
: ‘Tis not my place to say.
: I'm just a messenger.
: What I can tell you, though...
: Is that you are not prepared for what has yet to come.
: Do you believe in god GOD GoD God?
: What does that have to do with anything?..
: It’s a simple question.
: Surely you can answer it...can't you?
: Yes or no?
: Hmm...interesting.
: Perhaps you'd rather answer something like this, then-
: What waits for you at the end of the world?
: Is it something wonderful?
: Or is it-
: Something sad?...
Tears stream down the girl’s face and drop to the ground below her.
They mix with the sound of her umbrella as it cuts through the wind.
These are the only sounds we can hear.
Something is wrong.
: Are you...okay?
: Oh no...
: You don’t know...
: How simply tragic...
The girl locks eyes with me, ignoring Sana completely.
: You pitiful...lost soul...
: How will you ever find your way home?
: It’s okay...
: You don’t have to say anything...
: You’ll reach for salvation soon enough...
: And when you do, I’ll be there to catch you as you tumble further and further from everything.
: Sensei...what’s going on?...
: I have no idea...
: Of course you don’t.
: There’s no way you would.
: Not yet at least.
She pauses for an uncomfortably long time.
Neither myself nor Sana find it in ourselves to speak out.
: You’ve seen God.
: I can see it in your eyes.
: Oh, how envious I am...
: To think he’d grace you with his presence...
: And yet will do naught but speak with me.
: Should we maybe...call someone?...
: There’s no need...
: I see I’ve already overstayed my welcome.
: I suppose I’ll just go back to hiding now.
: Farewell, Sensei.
: May the path before you be lit and clear of callousness.
: And, to the girl in the black dress-
: Please know that he is happy now.
: Until we meet again...
The girl turns around and skips away from us, twirling her umbrella the entire time...
: ...Sana?
: What just...happened?
: Why are you crying?...
: I saw her tears and I just...
: I don’t know...
: I’m...scared...
: The world’s not really going to end...is it?
: Of course not. That was probably just some lunatic off of her medication.
: I wouldn’t think too much of it.
: I don’t want to but...
: My heart is beating so quickly...
Sana and I remain on the bench for another twenty minutes or so while she composes herself.
I try to reach for her hand to calm her down but she swats me away and seems even more adamant about not being touched than normal.
Why was that girl able to make a huge impact on her by just spouting nonsense?...
And who was she talking about in the end there?
Sana’s affection has increased to [sana_love]!
You walk her back to the dorm.
She trembles the entire way.
